name: Reacher CM
subtitle: Unsigned Reacher CM builds for LiveContainer and sideloading
description: Unsigned iOS builds of Reacher CM, a personal fork of the Reach SSH, SFTP, RDP and VNC client, made by GitHub Actions for each release.

apps.name: Reacher CM
apps.subtitle: SSH, SFTP, RDP and VNC client
apps.localizedDescription: Reacher CM is a personal fork of Reach with additional features: SSH, SFTP, RDP, VNC, Telnet and serial sessions, an encrypted vault and sync. This is an early, unsigned iOS build, meant for LiveContainer or for signing yourself.

versions.localizedDescription:
Reacher CM Dev 26.11.1-dev.11, a pre-release built from the fork's main.

New since v26.11.1-dev.10:

- More preferences sync by default
- DevOps tab in New session
- Fewer sidebar buttons
- Container hosts, database connections and Ansible/OpenTofu projects in the Sessions list
- Organization vaults on iOS and Android
- Managed Sync vault access
- Sync location starts on the Reacher CM account
- VeNCrypt for VNC sessions
- DevOps workspaces open as tabs, from the Sessions list
- Each person's own login in shared vaults
- My default SSH key
- Sync, Account and Backup settings reorganised
- Keys to switch tabs
- FTP/SFTP/SCP file sessions and the full-pane file manager on phones and tablets
- Better on Samsung DeX
- Notification position, history and system notifications
- Byobu and Zellij
- Keys no longer repeat by themselves on remote desktops
- QR code scanning on Android phones without Google
- Shorter tmux session name
- Missing session log folders
- Sync more application preferences
- Choose which preferences sync on each device
- Sign in to Account Sync from setup
- iDRAC VNC on phones and tablets

iPhone and iPad: add https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/update-feed/apps.json as a source in LiveContainer to get updates.
Full list of changes: https://github.com/rsipka/ReacherCM/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Reach connects to servers on your local network over SSH, RDP and VNC when you ask it to.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID unlocks your vault and the SSH keys you chose to remember with it.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera reads the QR code that links this device to your other one.
